## Checklist

- [ ] Branch name follows `game/<slug>` for a game contribution.
- [ ] Game-specific code and assets are isolated in its game folder.
- [ ] The game calls `onComplete` instead of calling the score API itself.
- [ ] A Flyway mission migration is included or the PR explains why it is unnecessary.
- [ ] `./scripts/check.sh` passes locally.
- [ ] No secrets, answer keys, or unrelated refactors are included.
